title: Viavi twin: phones without service
description: Record-based Davis anomaly detector on the Viavi twin's network records (service.name viavi-twin, sent by track3/adapters/twin_dt.py). Fires while the newest record of the last 3 minutes shows more than 13 phones without service (RSRP at or below -110 dBm). In Stan's saved run the twin has 9-10 before the S3 power failure, 16 after it and 12 after the fix. Breaking Barriers Track 3.

input.value:
fetch logs, from: -3m
| filter service.name == "viavi-twin" and twin.kind == "network"
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 1
| fieldsAdd phones = toDouble(twin.phones_without_service)
| filter phones > 13
| fields phones, active = twin.phones_active, worst_cell = twin.worst_cell, dark_cells = twin.dark_cells, run_id = twin.run_id

properties.value: Phones without service on the Viavi twin
The twin reports {phones} of {active} phones without service (RSRP at or below -110 dBm). Dark cells: {dark_cells}. Most of them are near cell {worst_cell}. Run {run_id}.
